Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
The legend himself! Classic Magic illustrator Dan Frazier defined “old school cool” with his work on the original Moxen and beyond. He even returned recently to grace Secret Lair with allied-color signet cards. This time, Dan’s turned back the clock on five allied-color talismans and we couldn’t be more thrilled with the results—especially seeing them retro-fitted with Retro frames!

Contents:
• 1x Retro Frame Talisman of Progress
• 1x Retro Frame Talisman of Dominance
• 1x Retro Frame Talisman of Indulgence
• 1x Retro Frame Talisman of Impulse
• 1x Retro Frame Talisman of Unity
